backend/main.mo: Actor implementing access control, user approvals, and profile CRUD with admin-restricted operations and map‑based profile storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend project files for routing, state, content, components, and pages.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining light/dark mode color tokens and global styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry file mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes and mounts all application pages within the AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen showing an admin‑only access restriction message with buttons to navigate home or to the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal for creating a new user profile with form fields and submission via saveCallerUserProfile.
frontend/src/components/common/BackToTop: Scroll‑activated floating button that smoothly scrolls the page to the top.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Root layout wrapping pages with Navbar, Footer, BackToTopButton, Toaster, and theme support.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: React footer component displaying navigation links, company info, and social/footer details with dynamic year and referral link.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Navba: Responsive navigation bar with links, login/signup handling via Internet Identity, and mobile menu support.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Profi: Dropdown profile menu showing user info, navigation shortcuts, and logout functionality tied to Internet Identity.
frontend/src/content/copy.ts: Centralized static copy for homepage, pricing page, creator onboarding, and related UI text blocks.
frontend/src/content/faqs.ts: Exports a typed FAQ list used to display common questions and answers about the platform.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and invalidates queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React authentication context and hook for managing DFINITY Internet Identity login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/usePageMeta.ts: React hook that updates document title and meta/OG tags based on provided options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, approvals, and roles through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables, base styles, utilities, and background texture effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point initializing React, React Query, Internet Identity, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page showing approval management and metrics, with access control and mutation actions.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: Billing page showing plan details and UPI payment actions, with login gating and clipboard/UPI link handling.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Blog listing page rendering static posts with metadata and preview cards.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Contact page offering email, live chat, and other support channels with navigation to support form.
frontend/src/pages/CreateStudioPage.tsx: Renders a form-driven page for generating AI-based design previews with user-selected options and simulated generation delay.
frontend/src/pages/CreatorProfilePage.ts: Displays a creator's profile with stats, portfolio grid, and tabbed content.
frontend/src/pages/CreatorsPage.tsx: Shows a directory of creators with basic stats and navigation to individual profiles.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Provides an authenticated user dashboard with profile info, plan details, and navigation tiles.
frontend/src/pages/FaqPage.tsx: Renders a FAQ list using an accordion component sourced from predefined FAQ content.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the marketing homepage with hero section, demo input preview, and feature highlights.
frontend/src/pages/LegalPrivacyPage.tsx: Renders the Privacy Policy page with sections outlining data collection, usage, security, and user rights while setting page metadata.
frontend/src/pages/LegalRefundPage.tsx: Displays the refund policy page including eligibility rules, steps for requesting refunds, subscription cancellation details, and template refund conditions.
frontend/src/pages/LegalTermsPage.tsx: Provides the Terms of Service page with terms on acceptable use, IP rights, payments, liability limits, and policy changes.
frontend/src/pages/MarketplacePage.tsx: Implements a marketplace page with tabbed browsing and sample template cards showing pricing, creator info, and engagement stats.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: Shows a 404 error page with navigation buttons to return home or browse the marketplace.
frontend/src/pages/PricingPage.tsx: Builds the pricing page with monthly/yearly toggle, plan details, feature lists, and upgrade logic tied to user identity.
frontend/src/pages/PublishPage.tsx: A template publishing form with type, image upload placeholder, title, description, and optional price, including login and validation checks.
frontend/src/pages/SupportPage.tsx: Support center page offering contact options and a form to submit support tickets with basic validation.
frontend/src/pages/TemplatesPage.tsx: Displays a grid of sample templates with preview cards and navigation to the template creation page.
frontend/src/state/planStore.ts: Zustand store for persisting user plan tier and billing period with helper permission checks.
frontend/src/utils/designPreview.ts: Generates deterministic SVG-based design previews using occasion-specific colors and input-driven variations.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage fallback.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, shadows, animations, and container settings with plugins.
project_state.json: JSON describing WishMint AI’s project state, including schema/version info, platform summary, known build issue, and a list of existing implemented features with IDs and versions.
